title: Characterization of a successful output bit
statement: Let $A$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, and let $x,u$ be bit strings and $v$ a bit. The attempt on input $x$ with choice string $u$ returns $v$ exactly when the run halts and outputs the one-bit string $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine
